channel.title: The Orange County Register - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Orange County Register (ocregister.com)

item.title: UCLA men trounced by No. 15 Michigan State to close rough trip
item.description: The Bruins trail the Spartans by 20 at halftime and by as much as 31 in the second half of an 82-59 defeat that follows their 30-point loss to then-No. 2 Michigan over the weekend. Tempers flare late.

item.title: Report: Lakers’ Deandre Ayton briefly detained in Bahamas on suspicion of marijuana possession
item.description: The 27-year-old Ayton, in his native country for the All-Star break, was set to fly back to Los Angeles when authorities briefly detained him after he allegedly smoked marijuana on the premises, TMZ reports.

item.title: CIF-SS boys soccer playoffs: Scores from Tuesday’s quarterfinals
item.description: The scores for the Orange County teams in the CIF-SS boys soccer playoffs Tuesday.

item.title: LAFC overwhelms Real España in CONCACAF Champions Cup opener
item.description: Denis Bouanga scores three goals as LAFC cruises to a 6-1 victory in Honduras in the first leg of the first-round matchup. LAFC will host the second leg next Tuesday night.

item.title: Santa Margarita boys basketball outgunned by Harvard-Westlake in Open Division
item.description: Santa Margarita isn't able to keep up with the hot shooting by Harvard-Westlake in the CIF-SS playoff game Tuesday.

item.title: Mater Dei boys basketball tops El Dorado to reach Division 2 semifinals
item.description: Mater Dei prevails despite some struggles in the fourth quarter. The Monarchs advance to the semifinals and will play at Hesperia on Friday.

item.title: Boys basketball playoffs: Crean Lutheran, JSerra advance to CIF-SS semifinals
item.description: OCVarsity's roundup has the highlights from the boys basketball games in the CIF-SS playoffs Tuesday.

item.title: Northwood and Laguna Hills fall in CIF-SS girls water polo semifinals
item.description: Northwood and Laguna Hills drop matches to San Dimas and San Bernardino in the Division 3 and Division 5 semifinals, respectively.

item.title: Canyon boys basketball falls to Bishop Amat in 2OTs in CIF-SS quarterfinals
item.description: Canyon goes from leading by 21 points to battling Bishop Amat through two overtime periods in the Division 2 quarterfinals.

item.title: Update: Weather alert issued for strong thunderstorms in 5 Freeway north of LA until early Wednesday
item.description: 5 Freeway north of LA is the focus of an updated weather alert for strong thunderstorms issued at 11:21 p.m. on Tuesday by the National Weather Service. The alert is in effect until Wednesday Feb. 18, at 12:15 a.m.
